notes: Shape of persona.json (saved next to the app, never shared). Filled in Persona setup.
under_18 is asked once on first start and sets the romance matrix (content_policy.md). null = not asked yet: the app asks before the first chat.
overrides: per-character changes, keyed by character id; any field left out uses the global value.
The system prompt's {persona_block} is built as: "{name}. {bio} How you met: {how_met}" (parts left out when empty).
Empty name -> {user_name} = "the person you're talking with" and {persona_block} = "Someone you met recently; you don't know much about them yet."
